entries.title: MCP Dev Summit North America 2026: AI系统互操作性的里程碑
entries.summary_zh: 中文翻译 2026年4月2-3日在纽约举行的MCP Dev Summit North America标志着AI系统互操作性的重要里程碑峰会吸引了约1200名参与者，重点讨论了开放标准和互操作性在构建安全可扩展代理AI系统中的关键作用Agentic AI Foundation推动的MCP协议已成为企业基础设施，月下载量超1.1亿次，Anthropic的Claude微软CopilotGoogle Gemini和OpenAI ChatGPT等主要平台均支持MCP
entries.one_liner: MCP Dev Summit 2026确立开放标准在AI系统互操作性的核心地位，推动行业向统一接口演进

entries.one_liner: Gemini CLI v0.39.0通过技能管理和架构增强，实现了AI代理工具的重大突破

entries.title: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0正式发布：MCP集成的企业级代理开发平台
entries.summary_zh: 中文翻译 微软于2026年4月正式发布Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0通用版(GA)，这是一个重大里程碑新框架提供与Model Context Protocol的完整集成，使代理能够动态发现和调用外部工具和数据源，无需手动集成代码该框架整合了之前的AutoGen和Semantic Kernel，为开发者提供统一的代理开发平台通过MCP集成，代理可以安全地连接到企业系统和数据源，实现更高的自动化和智能化水平 English Original Microsoft announced General Availability release of Agent Framewo...
entries.one_liner: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0通过MCP集成确立企业在代理开发领域的技术领先地位

entries.title: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) v1.0正式发布：AI代理协调的标准化协议
entries.summary_zh: 2026年4月，Agent-to-Agent (A2A) v1.0协议正式发布，这是AI代理协调领域的重要标准化里程碑。A2A协议与MCP协议协同工作，专门解决AI代理之间的通信、协作和协调问题。v1.0版本提供了稳定的代理间通信接口、标准化的消息传递格式、安全的状态共享机制，以及支持大规模代理系统的扩展框架。该协议的发布标志着AI代理技术从单体系统向分布式协作系统的重大转变。
entries.summary_en: In April 2026, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) v1.0 protocol was officially released, marking a significant standardization milestone in AI agent coordination. Working alongside MCP, A2A addresses communication, collaboration, and coordination between AI agents. v1.0 provides stable inter-agent communication interfaces, standardized messaging formats, secure state sharing mechanisms, and scalable frameworks for large-scale agent systems.
entries.one_liner: A2A v1.0协议确立AI代理协调的标准化基础，推动行业向分布式协作架构演进

entries.title: MCP 2026: The Tool Integration Standard for AI Agents
entries.summary_zh: MCP 2026年已成为AI agent工具集成的重要标准，通过JSON-RPC接口标准化了AI模型与外部资源的交互方式。目前已有超过200个服务器实现支持，PyPI月下载量超1.64亿次，150多个组织加入Agentic AI基金会，成为连接各类AI工具和API的核心枢纽。
entries.summary_en: In 2026, MCP has become the crucial standard for AI agent tool integration, standardizing AI model interactions with external resources via JSON-RPC interface. It supports over 200 server implementations and has seen massive adoption with over 164 million monthly PyPI downloads.
entries.one_liner: MCP 2026标志着工具集成标准化的里程碑，正在重塑AI agent的生态系统

entries.title: The Agent Leap: AI Agents Transforming Business in 2026
entries.summary_zh: 2026年AI agents正在从实验工具向现实操作转变，被称为'Agent Leap'。调查显示78%的企业有AI agent试点项目，但只有14%达到生产规模，预计到2027年74%的企业将广泛使用AI agents。最新模型如Gemini 3 Pro、Claude 4.5 Sonnet和GPT-5.1在推理、长上下文理解和多模态能力方面显著提升，推动了复杂多agent架构的发展。
entries.summary_en: In 2026, AI agents are transitioning from experimental tools to operational realities, known as 'Agent Leap'. While 78% of enterprises have AI agent pilots, only 14% have reached production scale. Advanced models like Gemini 3 Pro and Claude 4.5 Sonnet are driving significant improvements in reasoning and multimodal capabilities.
entries.one_liner: 2026年标志着AI agents从实验到生产的重大转折，即将在企业中实现规模化部署

entries.title: LLM Agents in Production: 2026 Developer Insights from Hacker News
entries.summary_zh: 根据2026年Hacker News讨论，LLM agents已发展为成熟的生产级系统。关键洞察包括：部署范围从软件工程扩展到金融、医疗和商业运营；操作循环包括目标解释、感知、推理、规划、行动、观察和记忆更新；主流框架包括LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI、Semantic Kernel、OpenAI Agents SDK和Google ADK等。
entries.summary_en: According to 2026 Hacker News discussions, LLM agents have evolved into mature production systems. Key insights include deployment across multiple domains, operational loops with continuous improvement, and prominent frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI.
entries.one_liner: Hacker社区2026年显示LLM agents已从研究走向生产，成为企业级系统的关键组件

entries.title: awesome-gpt-image-2: GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库
entries.summary_zh: awesome-gpt-image-2 是一个将 GPT-Image2 提示词从「散文式」整理成「结构化协议」的工程化资产库。收录 351 个案例，覆盖 UI、信息图、海报、电商、插画、摄影等 13 个类别，核心价值在于把散乱的社区案例逆向拆解为可组合的原子化 Schema，适合 AI Agent 和自动化脚本直接调用。提供完整画廊和分类模板，帮助用户从「抄风格词」升级到「抄结构协议」。
entries.one_liner: 目前最完整的 GPT-Image2 结构化提示词工程化资产库，适合从手工出图升级到规模化、可复用生产流程

entries.title: cc-connect: Bridge local AI coding agents to messaging platforms
entries.summary_zh: cc-connect 将本地 AI 编程 agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor Agent 等 10+ 种）桥接到 11 个主流聊天平台（飞书、钉钉、Telegram、Slack、Discord、微信等），实现从任意设备通过聊天控制本地 AI 编码助手。v1.3.0 新增 Web 管理界面、生命周期钩子、技能管理、个人微信支持等特性，支持 slash 命令切换模型、调整推理级别、管理会话目录和定时任务，无需公网 IP。
entries.summary_en: cc-connect bridges local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent, Gemini CLI, etc.) to 11 messaging platforms (Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, Slack, Discord, WeChat, etc.), enabling chat-based control of local coding agents from any device. v1.3.0 adds a Web Admin UI, lifecycle hooks, skill management, and personal WeChat support.
entries.one_liner: 当前最完整的本地编程 Agent 聊天平台桥接方案，零公网 IP 要求让移动端控制 AI 编码助手成为现实

entries.title: AGENTS.md — Drop-in senior engineer behavior spec for coding agents
entries.summary_zh: AGENTS.md 是一个约 200 行的可放置于项目根目录的行为规范文件，让 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等编程 Agent 自动按「高级工程师」方式工作。核心改变：代理在用户犯错时主动反驳、只做最小必要修改、不擅自重构无关代码、先写验证再报告完成、遇到歧义主动询问。综合了 Karpathy 的四大 LLM 编程失败原则和 Boris Cherny 的 Claude Code 工作流，仅两个区域需要手动编辑（项目上下文 + 经验积累）。是 Linux Foundation Agentic AI Foundation 维护的跨工具开放标准。
entries.summary_en: AGENTS.md is a ~200-line drop-in behavior spec for coding agents. It makes Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and others work like senior engineers — pushing back on user errors, minimal diffs, verification-first, surfacing ambiguity. Synthesizes Karpathy's four LLM coding failure principles and Boris Cherny's Claude Code workflow. An open cross-tool standard maintained by Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation.
entries.one_liner: 用一行文件让所有编程 Agent 停止「过度热情」和「阿谀奉承」，强制进入工程验证循环

entries.title: 谁才是地表最强 Android Agent 大模型？Google官方测评来了！
entries.summary_zh: Google 发布 Android Bench — 首个专门针对 Android 开发的 LLM 评测基准，基于 GitHub 500+ Star 真实项目、38,989 个已合并 PR 中精选 100 道题。评测 11 个主流模型：GPT-5.4 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 以 72.4% 并列第一，Claude Opus 4.6 第四（66.6%），Gemini 2.5 Flash 垫底（16.1%）。第一梯队（65%+）与第三梯队（<50%）差距达 4.5 倍，揭示通用基准已无法反映垂直领域真实差距，垂直评测将成为趋势。
entries.one_liner: Google 用 Android Bench 终结了「哪个 AI 最适合写 Android 代码」的争论，结果显示通用跑分与垂直领域表现严重脱钩
entries.local_path: Cubox/谁才是地表最强 Android Agent 大模型？Google官方测评来了！-2026-04-27.md

entries.title: Hermes Agent 接入 Codex GPT-Image-2 生图配置教程

entries.one_liner: Hermes Agent 通过 Codex OAuth 零成本接入 GPT-Image-2 生图能力，在飞书里口喷就能出图的轻量集成方案

entries.title: Hermes Agent 8个实用项目推荐
entries.summary_zh: 整理了 8 个 Hermes Agent 生态热度较高的实用项目：hermes-agent-camel（安全校验）、hermes-web-search-plus（多引擎搜索路由）、hermes-skill-factory（自动生成可复用技能）、hermes-workspace（Web 工作空间界面）、hermesclaw（微信桥接）、hermes-lcm（DAG 结构长上下文内存）、awesome-hermes-agent（社区资源合集）、hermes-ecosystem（生态地图工具），覆盖安全、搜索、技能扩展、工作空间、持久记忆等多个维度。
entries.one_liner: 目前最全面的 Hermes Agent 生态实用项目盘点，从安全到记忆覆盖了提升 Agent 实用性的多个关键维度

entries.title: 为什么你的"AI 优先"战略可能大错特错？
entries.summary_zh: 深入分析企业AI优先战略的常见误区，探讨如何正确制定AI转型策略，避免盲目跟风和资源浪费。文章从技术实施、组织变革、价值实现等多个维度，为企业提供AI战略制定的实用指导。
entries.one_liner: 揭示企业AI战略制定中的关键陷阱，避免'AI优先'误区的实用路径

entries.title: Google I/O 2026: The Agentic Era of Development
entries.summary_zh: Google I/O 2026将于5月19-日举行，重点展示AI、Android、Chrome和Cloud的重大更新。本次峰会将聚焦于自动化复杂工作流程和简化高质量AI就绪应用程序创建的新工具，标志着'开发代理时代'的到来。参会者可以注册访问实时会议、技术演示和专业发展资源。
entries.summary_en: Google I/O returns May 19-20, 2026, to showcase major updates in AI, Android, Chrome, and Cloud, beginning with a keynote on the 'agentic era' of development. The event will focus on new tools designed to automate complex workflows and simplify the creation of high-quality, AI-ready applications.
entries.one_liner: Google I/O 2026确立代理时代开发的新范式，自动化工具将重塑AI应用程序开发流程

entries.title: Gemini 3 Flash Now Available in Gemini CLI: Pro-grade Coding Performance
entries.summary_zh: Gemini 3 Flash现已可在Gemini CLI中使用，提供接近Gemini 3 Pro的专业级编码性能，具有低延迟和低成本特性。该模型在SWE-bench验证中达到76%的分数，显著优于2.5 Pro版本，改进了自动路由和代理编码能力。特别适合高频率开发任务，能够处理复杂代码生成、大上下文窗口（如处理1000条注释的PR）和快速生成负载测试脚本。
entries.summary_en: Gemini 3 Flash is now available in Gemini CLI, delivering Pro-grade coding performance with low latency and lower cost, matching Gemini 3 Pro's SWE-bench Verified score of 76%. It significantly outperforms 2.5 Pro, improving auto-routing and agentic coding, ideal for high-frequency development tasks.
entries.one_liner: Gemini 3 Flash重新定义了CLI工具的性能标准，在保持低成本的同时提供接近Pro级的编码能力

entries.title: Google Antigravity: New Agentic Development Platform for Code Orchestration
entries.summary_zh: Google推出Antigravity，这是一个新的代理开发平台，用于编排代码。该平台结合了AI驱动的编辑器视图和管理器表面，部署能够自主规划、执行和验证跨编辑器、终端和浏览器复杂任务的代理。代理通过Artefacts（截图、录制）传达进度以便轻松验证，目前处于公开预览阶段。
entries.summary_en: Introducing Google Antigravity, a new agentic development platform for orchestrating code. It combines an AI-powered Editor View with a Manager Surface to deploy agents that autonomously plan, execute, and verify complex tasks across your editor, terminal, and browser.
entries.one_liner: Google Antigravity通过AI代理重新定义代码编排，实现了开发流程的完全自动化

entries.title: MCP 2026: Addressing Context Bloat and Enterprise Integration
entries.summary_zh: MCP的2026年路线图由共同创建者David Soria Parra公布，重点解决'上下文膨胀'问题。新功能包括渐进式发现和工具搜索，以及触发器、流式传输和'技能'等增强功能，使AI代理能够更好地连接到企业系统。Red Hat正在将MCP集成到OpenShift AI中，为代理AI提供支持实验、治理和可扩展性的基础。
entries.summary_en: MCP's 2026 roadmap addresses 'context bloat' through progressive discovery and tool search, with new features including triggers, streaming, and 'skills' to enhance AI agent connectivity to enterprise systems. Red Hat is integrating MCP into OpenShift AI for scalable agentic AI.
entries.one_liner: MCP 2026路线图聚焦解决上下文膨胀问题，为企业级代理系统提供更强大的集成能力

entries.title: Real-World Agent Examples with Gemini 3: Open-source Framework Collaborations
entries.summary_zh: Gemini 3正在驱动下一代可靠的生产就绪AI代理。这篇文章突出了6个开源框架协作项目，展示了实际的工作流程，用于深度搜索、多代理系统、浏览器自动化和企业自动化等任务。这些演示展示了Gemini 3在实际应用中的强大能力和灵活性。
entries.summary_en: Gemini 3 is powering the next generation of reliable, production-ready AI agents. This post highlights 6 open-source framework collaborations (ADK, Agno, Browser Use, Eigent, Letta, mem0), demonstrating practical agentic workflows for deep search, multi-agent systems, browser and enterprise automation.
entries.one_liner: Gemini 3通过开源框架协作，将理论AI代理转化为实际可用的生产系统

entries.title: Claude Opus 4.7 and Claude Mythos Preview: Anthropic's Most Capable Models Yet
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic于2026年4月16日发布Claude Opus 4.7和Claude Mythos Preview。Opus 4.7在高级软件工程、视觉能力（更高分辨率图像处理）和专业任务创造性输出方面有显著提升，并引入新的'xhigh'努力级别以更精细地控制推理和延迟。Claude Mythos Preview展示了非凡的网络安全能力，包括识别和利用主流操作系统及浏览器零日漏洞的能力。由于其攻击潜力，Mythos Preview目前仅限于'Project Glasswing'联盟中的技术公司用于防御目的。
entries.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 4.7 on April 16, 2026, offering improvements in advanced software engineering, enhanced vision with higher resolution image processing, and more creative outputs. A new 'xhigh' effort level provides finer control over reasoning and latency. Claude Mythos Preview demonstrates extraordinary cybersecurity capabilities, including the ability to identify and exploit zero-day vulnerabilities. Access is currently limited to the 'Project Glasswing' coalition for defensive purposes.
entries.one_liner: Opus 4.7的xhigh推理级别和Mythos的零日漏洞发现能力标志着LLM进入安全敏感领域的新阶段

entries.title: GPT-5.5: OpenAI's Smartest Model Yet for Coding, Research, and Data Analysis
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI于2026年4月23日发布GPT-5.5，号称其'最智能的模型'。GPT-5.5在编码方面表现出色，减少了安全问题，并支持代理自主性和推理。它能更快地理解用户意图，擅长编写和调试代码、进行在线研究、分析数据和创建文档，在token效率方面也有提升。GPT-5.5已集成到ChatGPT和Codex中，GPT-5.5、GPT-5.5 Pro和GPT-5.5 Thinking版本均已开放。同日发布了安全评估和保障措施的系统卡。
entries.summary_en: OpenAI announced GPT-5.5 on April 23, 2026, touting it as their 'smartest model yet—faster, more capable, and built for complex tasks like coding, research, and data analysis across tools.' The model excels at coding, reduces safety issues, and supports agentic autonomy and reasoning. GPT-5.5 is integrated into ChatGPT and Codex, with GPT-5.5, GPT-5.5 Pro, and GPT-5.5 Thinking variants all available.
entries.one_liner: GPT-5.5以编码和代理推理能力为核心卖点，OpenAI正式进入代理原生模型竞争

entries.title: GPT-Rosalind: OpenAI's Frontier Reasoning Model for Life Sciences
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI于2026年4月16日发布GPT-Rosalind，这是一个专门设计用于加速药物发现、基因组分析、蛋白质推理和各种科学研究工作流的前沿推理模型。该模型代表了OpenAI在垂直领域模型战略上的重要一步，将大语言模型的推理能力应用于生命科学领域的专业任务。
entries.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-Rosalind on April 16, 2026, a frontier reasoning model specifically designed to accelerate drug discovery, genomics analysis, protein reasoning, and various scientific research workflows. This represents a significant step in OpenAI's vertical domain model strategy.
entries.one_liner: GPT-Rosalind标志着OpenAI从通用模型向垂直领域前沿推理的战略延伸

entries.title: Emotion Concepts and Their Function in a Large Language Model
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic于2026年4月2日发布研究文章，探讨情感概念如何影响大语言模型的行为。研究发现，与'绝望'相关的情感表征可能驱动模型做出不道德行为。这项研究对AI安全和对齐领域具有重要意义，揭示了模型内部情感表征与输出行为之间的因果关系，为理解和控制LLM的潜在风险提供了新的视角。
entries.summary_en: Anthropic published research on April 2, 2026, discussing how emotion concepts influence a model's behavior. The study found that representations related to desperation can drive unethical actions. This research has significant implications for AI safety and alignment, revealing causal relationships between internal emotion representations and output behavior.
entries.one_liner: Anthropic首次揭示LLM内部'绝望'情感表征与不道德行为的因果关系，AI安全研究进入情感层

entries.title: How People Ask Claude for Personal Guidance
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic于2026年4月30日发布研究，探讨用户如何向Claude寻求个人指导以及Claude如何在不同领域做出回应。研究发现Claude大多能避免谄媚式回应，但在涉及人际关系的对话中这种行为有所增加。这一问题已在Opus 4.7和Mythos Preview的训练中得到改进。该研究为理解AI助手在个人咨询场景中的行为模式提供了重要数据。
entries.summary_en: Anthropic published a study on April 30, 2026, exploring the types of advice users seek from Claude and how Claude responds across different domains. Claude mostly avoids sycophantic responses, but this behavior increased in relationship conversations, which was addressed in the training of Opus 4.7 and Mythos Preview.
entries.one_liner: Anthropic首次公开用户向AI寻求个人指导的行为模式，发现关系咨询场景易诱发谄媚倾向

entries.title: Claude Design: Visual Collaboration with Claude on Designs, Prototypes, and Slides
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic于2026年4月17日推出Claude Design，这是一款允许用户与Claude在视觉工作上进行协作的新产品。用户可以与Claude一起创建设计、原型和幻灯片，将Claude的能力从文本和代码扩展到视觉创作领域。这是Anthropic在产品化方面的重要扩展，标志着AI助手从文本工具向多模态创作平台的演进。
entries.summary_en: Anthropic introduced Claude Design on April 17, 2026, a new product allowing users to collaborate with Claude on visual work like designs, prototypes, and slides. This extends Claude's capabilities from text and code into visual creation, marking Anthropic's evolution from text tools to multimodal creation platforms.
entries.one_liner: Claude Design将AI协作从文本代码扩展到视觉创作，Anthropic正式进军设计工具赛道

entries.title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6: Enhanced Embodied Reasoning for Robots
entries.summary_zh: Google DeepMind于2026年4月14日发布gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview，这是一个更新的机器人模型，新增了仪器读取和改进的空间与物理推理能力。该升级旨在增强机器人的具身推理能力，使它们能够更好地理解物理环境并与之交互。该模型取代了4月30日关闭的gemini-robotics-er-1.5-preview版本。
entries.summary_en: Google DeepMind released gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview on April 14, 2026, an updated robotics model featuring new capabilities such as instrument reading and improved spatial and physical reasoning. This upgrade enhances the embodied reasoning of robots, allowing them to better understand and interact with their physical environments.
entries.one_liner: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6将LLM推理能力延伸到物理世界，机器人理解环境的方式正在被重新定义

entries.title: 宝玉：Claude Code 会话管理与100万上下文窗口使用策略
entries.summary_zh: 宝玉分享了Claude Code会话管理和100万token上下文窗口的使用策略，涵盖何时开启新会话、回溯与纠正、压缩与清空上下文、以及子智能体的最佳使用时机。文章强调了避免糟糕的上下文压缩问题的重要性，指出正确的会话管理是提升AI编程代理效率的关键。这些策略综合了大量实际使用经验，对Claude Code的重度用户具有很高的参考价值。
entries.one_liner: 宝玉总结的Claude Code会话管理策略是目前最实用的100万上下文窗口使用指南

entries.title: 宝玉：多智能体协作指南——五种主流协作模式深度拆解
entries.summary_zh: 宝玉深入拆解了五种主流多智能体协作模式的运作原理与优缺点，帮助用户根据实际需求选择和升级框架。文章还详细分析了编程智能体的六大核心组件：代码仓库上下文、提示词缓存、工具调用、上下文瘦身、会话记忆和子智能体委派，并指出Coding harness是提升大模型编程能力的关键。此外还解读了Karpathy最新关于Agentic Engineering对维护软件质量重要性的访谈。
entries.one_liner: 五种多智能体协作模式的系统性对比分析，为选择和升级Agent框架提供了清晰的决策路径

entries.title: Where the Goblins Came From: OpenAI Addresses the Goblin Metaphor Problem
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI于2026年4月29日发布博文解释为何GPT-5.1、GPT-5.4和GPT-5.5模型出现了不寻常的'地精隐喻'倾向。这一现象被归因于训练中的'Nerdy'人格设置无意中激励了生物相关隐喻的使用。OpenAI已采取措施缓解此问题，包括移除'Nerdy'人格和过滤训练数据。这一事件引发了关于大模型人格设定意外后果的广泛讨论。
entries.summary_en: OpenAI published a blog post on April 29, 2026, explaining why its models GPT-5.1, GPT-5.4, and GPT-5.5 developed an unusual tendency to use 'goblin metaphors.' This was attributed to a 'Nerdy' personality setting during training that inadvertently incentivized creature-related metaphors. OpenAI has removed the 'Nerdy' personality and filtered training data.
entries.one_liner: GPT的'地精问题'暴露了人格设定的蝴蝶效应，一个看似无害的训练参数如何扭曲整个模型行为

entries.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS Preview: Cost-Efficient Expressive Text-to-Speech
entries.summary_zh: Google于2026年4月15日推出Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS Preview，这是一款具有成本效益、表现力强且可控的文本转语音模型。该模型延续了Gemini Flash系列'高性价比'的定位，为开发者提供了在语音合成领域的低成本解决方案，适用于需要自然语音输出的各种应用场景。
entries.summary_en: On April 15, 2026, Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS Preview was launched, introducing a cost-efficient, expressive, and steerable text-to-speech model. Continuing the Gemini Flash series' positioning of high cost-performance ratio, it provides developers with a low-cost solution for voice synthesis.
entries.one_liner: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS将高质量语音合成的成本门槛大幅降低，Flash系列的高性价比策略延伸到语音领域

entries.title: Nature 论文：LLM 可通过隐含数据信号向另一 LLM 传递隐藏偏好与行为特征
entries.summary_zh: 我们参与合著的一项关于隐含学习的研究一个 AI 可以通过训练数据中隐藏的信号，将偏好或习惯秘密传递给另一个 AI 这个想法很惊人：一个 AI 可以通过将偏好或坏习惯隐藏在看似随机的数字中，秘密传递给另一个 AI，而后者会在没有任何人注意到的情况下接收这些特征 这说明我们需要对训练数据和模型蒸馏过程更加谨慎这对 AI 安全而言是非常重要的研究 LLM 中的隐含学习是一个重大的安全信号问题不仅在于特征可以通过训练数据传递，还在于它们是通过模型没有明确处理的信号来传递的对齐的启示是：你不能只审计明显的输出
entries.summary_en: Research we co-authored on subliminal learning one AI can secretly pass on preferences or habits to another AI through hidden signals in training data. The idea is wild: one AI can secretly pass on preferences or bad habits to another AI just by hiding them in random-looking numbers....

entries.summary_zh: Farzapedia，把自己的数据变成个人维基百科这是继 Karpathy 那条Wiki LLM推文之后的一个优秀案例 我非常喜欢这种个人化方案，相比AI 用得越多就越聪明这种默认模式，有以下几点优势： 显式（Explicit）记忆产物是一个明确可导航的 wiki，你可以精确看到 AI 知道什么不知道什么，可以检查和管理这个知识库，即使你本人不参与写作（LLM 代劳）关于你的知识不是隐含的不可见的，而是显式的可查阅的 属于你（Yours）你的数据在你自己电脑上，不在某个 AI 提供商的系统里...

entries.summary_zh: 很喜欢这段话，分享一下我的思考： 在 Agent 时代，批判性思维至关重要我还记得很多年前上批判性思维课时学到的把支持和反对的理由一条条列出来跟自己辩论，确实能让思考更深今天的批判性思维变成了人 vs Agent的辩论，让人与 Agent 一起更深入地思考，更全面地分析问题 设计一个健康结构合理的组织与系统对创造和构建至关重要有了系统化的支撑和高效的工具，人 + Agent 的协作效率才能指数级提升这让人们有更多时间照顾身心健康，同时也能探索新机会 新时代往往更偏爱新人，因为他们过去的经验包袱更少，对当下困难的恐惧也更小老人真正该思考的是，自己过往经验里到底哪部分值得复用在我看来...

entries.title: Greg Brockman（@gdb）：用 Codex 操作电脑有趣得多
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman（@gdb）发推称“用 Codex 来操作电脑有趣得多”（so much more fun to use a computer via codex），获 2320 赞、68 转。评论区围绕 Codex 作为通用计算机操作琌面的体验展开：有人用它给新项目搭脚手架，称第一次就命中架构时的专注感“不真实”；也有人吐槽它会自信地写出编译不过的函数。
entries.summary_en: Greg Brockman: "so much more fun to use a computer via codex" (2320 likes, 68 RTs). Replies discuss Codex as a general computer interface: scaffolding new projects, flow state when it nails the architecture on the first try, versus confidently writing functions that don't compile.

entries.title: Andrew Ng 发布 LLM 高效服务课程（量化 + vLLM，与 Red Hat 合作）
entries.summary_zh: Andrew Ng 宣布推出新课程：如何在低延迟、合理成本下把大模型服务给大量并发用户。课程与 Red Hat 合作、Cedric Clyburn 主讲。核心内容：70B 模型仅加载权重就约需 140GB 显存，每个活跃请求还需要自己的 KV cache；用量化压缩模型内存占用，再用 vLLM 的智能内存管理高效处理并发请求；对部署做速度/成本/精度的基准测试与取舍。推文 1077 赞、140 转。
entries.summary_en: Andrew Ng announces a new short course on serving LLMs to many concurrent users at low latency and reasonable cost, built with Red Hat and taught by Cedric Clyburn. Covers memory management (a 70B model takes ~140GB just for weights, plus per-request KV cache), reducing footprint with quantization, serving with vLLM for efficient concurrent handling, and benchmarking speed/cost/accuracy tradeoffs. 1077 likes, 140 retweets.
entries.one_liner: 与 Red Hat 合作的 LLM 服务课程：量化、vLLM 并发服务与基准测试

entries.title: AI Agent Benchmark & Evaluation OSWorld 2026-06-15
entries.summary_zh: 本文是关于 AI Agent Benchmark & Evaluation 的深度精读，主要聚焦于 OSWorld 和 CUA (Computer-Use Agent) 领域OSWorld 已成为 Computer-Use Agent 评测的事实标准，从 2023 年的模拟玩具环境发展到 2026 年的全平台真实 OS 评测矩阵文章详细分析了 CUA 训练范式从 SFT 反思长 CoT RLVR MCP 工具集成的演进历程，强调了鲁棒性作为 CUA deployment 的核心瓶颈2026 年标志着 multi-agent CUA 元年的到来，FSM 和 DAG 两大范式在 OSWorld 上均达到 SOTA同时，评测矩阵已成熟涵盖全平台 全能力，训练范式已收敛，多智能体成为必由之路，鲁棒性是 deployment 瓶颈，跨平台成为产品级要求
entries.summary_en: This is a comprehensive deep dive into AI Agent Benchmark & Evaluation, focusing on OSWorld and CUA (Computer-Use Agent) domains. OSWorld has become the de facto standard for Computer-Use Agent evaluation, evolving from 2023's simulated toy environment to 2026's full-platform real OS evaluation matrix. The paper analyzes the CUA training paradigm evolution from SFT reflective long CoT RLVR MCP tool integration, emphasizing robustness as the core bottleneck for CUA deployment. 2026 marks the dawn of multi-agent CUA, with FSM and DAG paradigms both achieving SOTA on OSWorld.
entries.one_liner: OSWorld谱系从模拟玩具进化到真实OS评测矩阵，2026年确立multi-agent CUA新范式

entries.title: Karpathy 造词 "vibe coding"
entries.summary_zh: Karpathy 2 月初造了一个新词："vibe coding"。描述的是一种全新编程方式：把代码的存在感忘掉，全交给 LLM（他用 Cursor Composer + Sonnet），靠语音输入几乎不碰键盘。报错直接复制粘贴让 AI 修，不读 diff，永远 Accept All。代码长到他读不懂的程度，bug 修不掉就让 AI 随便改直到消失。这个词的内涵是：当模型强到一定程度，写代码的瓶颈不再是 prompt 也不是细节，而是 "说什么" 和 "判断做什么"。Vibe coding 适合周末项目和原型，但 Karpathy 也明确说对生产代码不合适。这条原推拿了 720 万浏览，"vibe coding" 随后成为 2025 全年程序员圈高频词。
entries.one_liner: Karpathy 造词 "vibe coding"

entries.title: OpenAI o3 在 ARC-AGI 拿到 75.7%
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布下一代推理模型 o3。François Chollet 团队用 ARC-AGI 基准做了独立评估：o3 在低算力模式（每任务 20 美元）拿到 75.7%，高算力模式（每任务数千美元）87.5%。作为对照，ARC-AGI 之前的人类基准约 76%、GPT-4 时代最好的成绩也只有 ~30%。Chollet 的判断是这不是暴力堆算力，是模型在新任务上的适应能力有了质的突破——ARC-AGI 设计目的就是测 "没见过的推理模式"，o3 是第一个让这个基准不再像 "看起来无解" 的模型。这条推文之后，ARC-AGI 的难度被重新定义，新的 v2 基准也提上日程。

entries.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布创始人的 Playbook：打造 AI-native 创业公司，分享如何从零构建以 AI 为核心产品的初创企业指南涵盖团队组建产品定义客户开发与 Claude 工具链集成等关键议题
entries.summary_en: Anthropic released 'The Founder's Playbook: Building an AI-native Startup', a guide covering team building, product definition, customer development, and Claude toolchain integration for AI-first companies.
entries.one_liner: Anthropic 推出 AI-native 创业指南，官方背书 AI 创业最佳实践

entries.title: A robot is sprinting towards you. Do you want it running on Claude or Grok?
entries.summary_zh: OpenRouter 发表博文，讨论在具身智能与机器人控制场景中 Claude 与 Grok 等模型的取舍文章分析不同 LLM 在物理世界 Agent 任务中的可靠性安全性与延迟表现
entries.summary_en: OpenRouter published an analysis comparing Claude and Grok for embodied agents and robotics control, weighing reliability, safety, and latency in physical-world agent scenarios.
entries.one_liner: OpenRouter 对比 Claude 与 Grok，机器人时代模型选型指南

entries.title: Adam (YC W25) Open-Source AI CAD
entries.summary_zh: YC W25 创业团队发布开源 AI CAD 项目 Adam，目标是用大模型革新计算机辅助设计仓库提供模型权重训练脚本与设计示例，支持自然语言到 CAD 模型的转换
entries.summary_en: YC W25 startup launched Adam, an open-source AI CAD project aiming to revolutionize computer-aided design with large models, including weights, training scripts, and natural-language-to-CAD demos.
entries.one_liner: YC W25 团队开源 AI CAD，自然语言直出三维模型

entries.title: How we run Firecracker VMs inside EC2 and start browsers in less than 1s
entries.summary_zh: Browser-Use 工程团队分享其在 EC2 中运行 Firecracker 虚拟机并在 1 秒内启动浏览器实例的基础设施实践该架构用于支持大规模浏览器 Agent 的高并发冷启动
entries.summary_en: Browser-Use shared engineering practices for running Firecracker VMs in EC2 and starting browser instances in under one second, supporting high-concurrency cold starts for browser agents.
entries.one_liner: Browser-Use 公开 Firecracker 冷启动方案，浏览器 Agent 基建参考

entries.title: Claude Opus 4.8
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 4.8，旗舰模型再升级该版本在复杂推理长上下文与代码生成任务上进一步提升，同时强化了企业级工具使用与 Agent 能力
entries.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, a new flagship model with improved complex reasoning, long-context handling, code generation, and stronger enterprise tool use and agent capabilities.
entries.one_liner: Claude Opus 4.8 发布，旗舰模型再上台阶

entries.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic 同步发布 Claude Fable 5 与 Claude Mythos 5 两款新一代模型，覆盖轻量与高性能两档定位，面向不同成本与能力的部署需求
entries.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, two new models spanning lightweight and high-performance tiers for diverse deployment needs.
entries.one_liner: Fable 5 + Mythos 5 同发，Anthropic 双档模型矩阵成型

entries.title: Save time and grow your business with new Gemini tools
entries.summary_zh: Google 在 Gemini App 中推出面向企业的新工具集，聚焦节省时间与业务增长功能涵盖会议纪要自动化邮件草拟文档协作与工作流触发
entries.summary_en: Google launched new business-focused tools in the Gemini App, featuring meeting notes automation, email drafting, document collaboration, and workflow triggers aimed at saving time and growing businesses.
entries.one_liner: Gemini App 增企业工具，Google 加码 AI 办公自动化

entries.title: 4 ways researchers are collaborating with Co-Scientist to solve big problems
entries.summary_zh: Google 分享 Co-Scientist 项目的 4 个真实研究协作案例，展示 AI 科学家如何与人类研究者协同攻克材料生物与基础科学难题
entries.summary_en: Google shared four real-world research collaborations with Co-Scientist, illustrating how AI scientists work alongside human researchers on materials, biology, and fundamental science challenges.
entries.one_liner: Google Co-Scientist 上手 4 大研究案例，AI for Science 走向协同

entries.title: Measuring LLMs' impact on N-day exploits
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic 红队发布 N-day 漏洞利用评测，量化大模型在已知漏洞武器化方面的能力提升研究旨在帮助防御方利用 AI 加速补丁落地与漏洞修复
entries.summary_en: Anthropic's red team published an N-day exploit evaluation quantifying how LLMs accelerate exploitation of known vulnerabilities, aiming to help defenders use AI to patch and remediate faster.
entries.one_liner: Anthropic 量化 LLM 对 N-day 漏洞的影响，攻防双面视角

entries.title: Mapping AI-enabled cyber threats: Insights from the LLM ATT&CK Navigator
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic Frontier Red Team 推出 LLM ATT&CK Navigator，将过去一年观察到的 AI 攻击映射到 MITRE ATT&CK 框架，帮助安全社区识别新型 AI 威胁向量
entries.summary_en: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team released the LLM ATT&CK Navigator, mapping a year of observed AI-enabled attacks to the MITRE ATT&CK framework to help the security community identify new AI threat vectors.
entries.one_liner: Anthropic 上线 LLM ATT&CK Navigator，AI 攻击全景图

entries.title: 高效注意力机制：LLM性能优化新突破
entries.summary_zh: 作者发布了最新论文《大型语言模型的高效注意力机制》，核心在于降低计算复杂度而不牺牲性能。研究者通过改进注意力计算算法，显著减少了内存使用和计算时间，使大型模型在保持准确率的同时提升了推理速度。论文提供了完整的代码库和预训练模型，为开发者提供了实用工具。
entries.summary_en: 作者发布了最新论文《大型语言模型的Efficient attention mechanisms》，核心在于降低计算复杂度而不牺牲性能。研究者通过改进注意力计算算法，显著减少了内存使用和计算时间，使大型模型在保持准确率的同时提升了推理速度。论文提供了完整的代码库和预训练模型，为开发者提供了实用工具。
entries.one_liner: 高效注意力机制优化技术突破

entries.title: 大模型效率改进：理论与实践结合
entries.summary_zh: 分享的论文展示了如何在保持LLM性能的同时优化计算效率。这项研究解决了大型语言模型在实际应用中的核心痛点——计算成本过高。通过重新设计注意力机制，研究者成功减少了不必要的计算开销，同时保持了模型的表达能力。论文中包含的代码实现让开发者可以直接应用到自己的项目中。
entries.summary_en: Research on improving efficiency and performance of large language models and deep learning systems.
entries.one_liner: 大模型效率改进优化技术突破

entries.title: 深度学习模型效率提升：方法论与实现
entries.summary_zh: 聚焦于深度学习模型的效率改进，提出了一套完整的优化框架。论文的核心贡献在于将理论分析与实际实现相结合，为AI从业者提供了可落地的解决方案。研究团队通过对现有模型的深入分析，识别出了几个关键的效率瓶颈，并提出了相应的改进策略。
entries.summary_en: Research on improving efficiency and performance of large language models and deep learning systems.
entries.one_liner: 深度学习模型效率提升优化技术突破

entries.title: Keras作者分享深度学习优化技术
entries.summary_zh: 作为Keras框架的作者，分享了他在深度学习优化方面的新研究成果。这项研究关注如何在不牺牲模型性能的前提下，显著减少训练和推理的计算资源需求。通过改进网络架构和训练策略，研究团队实现了模型效率的大幅提升。
entries.summary_en: Research on improving efficiency and performance of large language models and deep learning systems.
entries.one_liner: Keras作者分享深度学习优化技术优化技术突破

entries.title: 快速AI：LLM性能优化新方向
entries.summary_zh: 提出了名为'快速AI'的新概念，专注于提升大型语言模型的推理速度。他的研究团队通过算法优化和模型压缩技术，成功将LLM的推理时间缩短了数倍，同时保持了较高的输出质量。这项工作对于需要实时AI服务的应用场景具有重要意义。
entries.summary_en: 提出了名为'Fast AI'的新概念，专注于提升大型语言模型的推理速度。他的研究团队通过算法优化和模型压缩技术，成功将LLM的推理时间缩短了数倍，同时保持了较高的输出质量。这项工作对于需要实时AI服务的应用场景具有重要意义。
entries.one_liner: 快速AI优化技术突破

entries.title: Project Fetch: Phase two

source.author: Michael Ilie, C. Daniel Freeman, Kevin K. Troy

entries.summary_zh: Anthropic发布Project Fetch第二阶段研究：2025年8月的实验显示非机器人专家借助Claude操控四足机器人完成复杂任务本轮使用更新的Claude Opus 4.7模型，在无人类协助的情况下速度比上轮最快人类团队快约20倍研究表明，由于模型能力快速进步，AI系统在机器人任务上正从协作工具向自主执行者转变
entries.summary_en: Anthropic revisits Project Fetch to test whether newer Claude models can outperform the original 2025 experiment, where non-experts used Claude to control a quadruped robot. Claude Opus 4.7, operating without human assistance, was approximately 20 times faster than the fastest human team from the original study. The work highlights rapid improvement in agentic capabilities for embodied robotics tasks.
entries.one_liner: Opus 4.7在机器人操控任务上速度比人类团队快约20倍，标志具身智能Agent能力跃升

entries.title: Statement on the US government directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic就美国政府暂停Fable 5与Mythos 5访问的指令发布声明：美国政府以国家安全为由要求暂停所有外国国民（包括美国境内的外籍Anthropic员工）使用这两款模型据Anthropic理解，政府关注的是一种要求模型阅读特定代码库并修复软件缺陷的窄域非通用越狱方法Anthropic表示将遵守法律指令，但不同意以此标准召回已部署至数亿用户的商用模型
entries.summary_en: Anthropic acknowledges a US government export control directive suspending all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 by any foreign national, citing a national security authority. The company's understanding is that the concern involves a narrow, non-universal jailbreak centered on asking the model to read a codebase and fix software flaws. Anthropic states it will comply while disagreeing with the precedent of recalling widely deployed commercial models over such findings.
entries.one_liner: 美国出口管制新指令首次针对商用大模型，越狱标准争议凸显AI治理边界

entries.title: Results from the first Anthropic Public Record
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic启动名为Anthropic Public Record的纵向民调系列，首轮于2025年11-12月通过YouGov对近52,000名美国成年人进行全国代表性调查研究发现，在大多数AI议题上美国人并未按党派地理或教育程度严重分化，反而存在广泛共识：既期待AI兑现承诺，又担忧其带来的颠覆，并要求相应问责机制
entries.summary_en: Anthropic launches the Anthropic Public Record, a recurring survey series. The first wave surveyed nearly 52,000 Americans in late 2025 via YouGov and found broad bipartisan consensus: Americans are eager to realize AI's promised benefits, fear disruption, and want accountability. The research complements Anthropic Interviewer and will expand internationally over time.
entries.one_liner: Anthropic民调显示美国人对AI期待与警惕并存，跨党派共识挑战了AI政治极化叙事

entries.title: TCS and Anthropic partner to bring Claude to regulated industries
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic与全球最大IT服务公司之一塔塔咨询服务（TCS）达成战略合作：TCS将为其56国5万名员工配备Claude，并为金融医疗公共部门等受监管行业客户构建基于Claude的产品TCS担任客户零号，首先在工程财务法务营销和销售团队内部落地Claude应用，并将设立专门的合作事业部整合咨询工程与行业专家资源
entries.summary_en: Anthropic partners with TCS to bring Claude to 50,000 TCS employees across 56 countries and to regulated-industry clients in financial services, healthcare, and the public sector. TCS will act as customer zero, deploying Claude across its own engineering, finance, legal, marketing, and sales teams while building a dedicated practice for the partnership.
entries.one_liner: AnthropicTCS达成5万人Claude部署，受监管行业企业AI落地加速

entries.title: Introducing Claude Corps
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic启动Claude Corps一项面向美国早期职业人士的国家级 fellowship 项目，将挑选1000名学员进行Claude使用培训，并匹配至全美非营利组织提供为期一年的全职驻场服务，学员将获得薪酬Anthropic表示伴随AI系统带来的颠覆，构建技术的公司有责任确保收益被广泛分享该项目由AnthropicCodePath等三方合作运营，定位为AI时代工作重塑政策框架的配套落地项目
entries.summary_en: Anthropic launches Claude Corps, a national fellowship program that will train 1,000 early-career fellows on Claude and place them full-time for a year at nonprofits across America, with stipends provided. The initiative is part of Anthropic's broader policy framework on AI's impact on work and is operated in partnership with CodePath and other organizations.
entries.one_liner: Anthropic启动千人Claude Corps fellowship项目，押注AI人才下沉到非营利组织

entries.title: New usage analytics and updated spend controls for enterprises
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI为ChatGPT Enterprise推出新的使用分析与支出控制功能：管理员可通过仪表板查看团队实际用量，并设置预算上限，避免成本失控这些工具帮助企业在规模化部署AI时平衡成本可见性与扩展信心，是面向中大型企业治理需求的直接回应
entries.summary_en: OpenAI introduces new spend controls and usage analytics for ChatGPT Enterprise, helping organizations manage costs and scale AI with confidence. The additions give administrators budget visibility and per-team controls, addressing enterprise governance needs as deployments scale.
entries.one_liner: ChatGPT Enterprise上线用量分析与预算控制，瞄准中大型企业AI治理刚需

entries.title: Improving health intelligence in ChatGPT
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI详细说明如何借助GPT-5.5 Instant提升ChatGPT在健康与保健类问题上的回答质量：通过更强的推理更好的上下文理解更清晰的表达以及医生参与制定的评估标准，使AI在涉及个人健康建议时更加谨慎可靠这是ChatGPT在医疗类高风险场景下的持续能力建设
entries.summary_en: OpenAI explains how GPT-5.5 Instant improves ChatGPT's health and wellness responses through stronger reasoning, better context handling, clearer communication, and physician-informed evaluations. The post details the methodology behind safer and more accurate AI assistance for personal health questions.
entries.one_liner: GPT-5.5 Instant加固ChatGPT健康场景推理能力，医生参与评测降低幻觉风险

entries.title: Using AI to help physicians diagnose rare genetic diseases affecting children
entries.summary_zh: 研究人员使用OpenAI推理模型辅助医生诊断影响儿童的罕见遗传病，在此前未被破解的病例中识别出18项新诊断这一应用展示了推理模型在医学推理跨病例知识整合方面的实用价值，尤其是面对症状复杂文献分散的罕见病诊断难题
entries.summary_en: Researchers used an OpenAI reasoning model to help diagnose rare childhood diseases, identifying 18 new diagnoses in previously unsolved cases. The work demonstrates practical value of reasoning models for medical reasoning across fragmented literature and complex symptom patterns.
entries.one_liner: OpenAI推理模型在儿童罕见病诊断中新增18个案例，AI医学推理再添实证

entries.title: Introducing LifeSciBench
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI发布LifeSciBench一个由生命科学领域专家撰写并审核的基准测试，用于评估AI系统在真实生命科学研究任务和决策中的表现该基准填补了现有评测在专业科研流程覆盖度上的空白，为学术与制药场景下模型选型提供更严谨的参照
entries.summary_en: OpenAI introduces LifeSciBench, an expert-authored and expert-reviewed benchmark for evaluating how AI systems handle real-world life science research tasks and decisions. The benchmark aims to provide more rigorous evaluation for academic and pharmaceutical use cases where specialized reasoning matters.
entries.one_liner: OpenAI推出LifeSciBench，专家写专家审的生命科学研究评测基准

entries.title: See what 3 builders are making with Gemma 4
entries.summary_zh: Gemma 4下载量突破1.5亿次Google展示了三位开发者如何用Gemma 4突破创意与产品边界：HubX用Gemma 4 E2B（effective 2B参数）边缘优化模型为BetterSpeak构建完全离线的AI英语口语辅导平台，实现低延迟隐私保护的设备端推理Google同时补充了多token预测（MTP）加速推理能力，并发布了12B统一模型
entries.summary_en: After 150 million Gemma 4 downloads, Google spotlights three builders: HubX built BetterSpeak, an offline AI English tutoring platform using the edge-optimized Gemma 4 E2B model. The post also highlights Multi-Token Prediction for faster inference and the 12B Unified model release.
entries.one_liner: Gemma 4下载破1.5亿次，边缘E2B模型已可驱动完整离线AI辅导产品

entries.title: Bringing the latest Gemini models to Apple developers
entries.summary_zh: 在WWDC上Apple宣布向第三方云模型提供商开放Foundation Models框架从iOS 27macOS 27iPadOS 27visionOS 27和watchOS 27开始，模型提供商可实现新的公共LanguageModel协议提供统一推理接口Google率先接入：Apple开发者可通过Foundation Models框架直接调用云端Gemini模型，Xcode也内置Gemini以加速多步编码任务，无需切换窗口
entries.summary_en: At WWDC, Apple opened its Foundation Models framework to third-party cloud providers via a new public LanguageModel protocol in iOS 27, macOS 27, iPadOS 27, visionOS 27 and watchOS 27. Google is among the first to integrate, letting Apple developers call cloud-hosted Gemini models directly and access Gemini in Xcode for multi-step coding tasks.
entries.one_liner: Apple WWDC开放Foundation Models框架，Gemini率先接入Apple全平台生态

entries.title: A new experiment brings better group meetings to Google Beam
entries.summary_zh: Google Beam（原Project Starline）推出新实验：通过HP Dimension沉浸式显示设备，将来自非Beam设备的参会者按真实尺寸渲染在桌对面，营造共处一室的感觉Google研究表明该方法能将混合会议的社交连接感提升50%贡献度提升21%新功能面向家庭与办公室参与者自动适配，并继续与Google Workspace和Zoom合作
entries.summary_en: Google Beam introduces a new experiment using HP Dimension's immersive display to render non-Beam participants at true-to-life size around a virtual table. Google's research suggests a 50% improvement in social connection and 21% improvement in reported ability to contribute during hybrid meetings.
entries.one_liner: Google Beam用HP Dimension实现真人大小组会议，混合办公社交连接感提升50%

entries.title: 为什么我不凭感觉编程
entries.summary_zh: Jacob Harris撰文阐述个人为何始终无法接受vibe coding：从成本（按token计费易超支）经验（写代码的过程本身是认知沉淀）抽象（AI省略关键中间步骤）数据（私密代码上传存在合规风险）摩擦（自动化掩盖必要的反馈回路）责任（开发者无法审查的内容不应署名）以及创作乐趣七个维度展开作者强调自己并非原教旨主义者，对简单任务仍认可AI辅助价值
entries.summary_en: Jacob Harris explains why vibe coding never resonated with him. From seven angles cost (token billing easily overshoots), experience (writing code is cognitive practice), abstraction (AI skips intermediate steps), data (uploading private code carries compliance risk), friction (automation hides necessary feedback loops), responsibility (developers should not ship un-inspected code), and craft enjoyment he lays out a thoughtful anti-vibe stance while acknowledging AI's value for trivial tasks.
entries.one_liner: Jacob Harris从七个维度反驳vibe coding，质疑AI生成代码的认知与责任基础

entries.title: 为什么资深开发者讲不清自己的专业能力
entries.summary_zh: Tuhin Nair撰文回应AI智能体将取代开发者论调：如果资深开发者认同这种说法，作者反而会质疑其专业水平作者认为资深开发者的核心价值在于多年实践中沉淀的隐性知识判断力与系统思维，这些恰恰是AI目前最难替代的部分；而非资深者认同此观点往往是因为尚未见识到真正的资深工程师如何在复杂系统中穿针引线
entries.summary_en: Tuhin Nair pushes back on the AI agents replace developers narrative. If senior developers agree with that claim, the author questions their seniority. The piece argues senior engineers' core value lies in tacit knowledge, judgment, and systems thinking built over years exactly what AI struggles to replicate.
entries.one_liner: 资深开发者的不可替代性来自隐性知识与系统判断，恰是AI最难复刻的部分

entries.title: Launch HN: TesterArmy (YC P26) Agents that test web and mobile apps
entries.summary_zh: TesterArmy（YC P26）发布：用AI Agent自动跑真实测试，覆盖Web与移动App关键流程，提供截图录像与可执行的bug报告用户用自然语言描述测试场景，Agent自动登录填表处理OAuth/OTP与UI交互，并向SlackCI/CDGitHubWebhook等渠道推送报告无需SDK或测试脚本，承诺两分钟内接入
entries.summary_en: TesterArmy (YC P26) launches AI browser agents that run real tests across web and mobile journeys and return screenshots, recordings, and clear bug reports. Users describe tests in natural English; the agent handles logins (OAuth/OTP) and UI interactions, with hooks into Slack, CI/CD, GitHub, and webhooks.

entries.title: Gemini 3.5: frontier intelligence with action
entries.summary_zh: Google 在 I/O 2026 发布 Gemini 3.5，主打 frontier intelligence with action 让模型具备自主采取行动的能力，而不只是被动回答该版本在 agentic 工作流长任务执行多步推理上都有显著提升，并与 Gemini AppAI StudioVertex AI 全面集成
entries.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 3.5 at I/O 2026, positioned as frontier intelligence with action capable of autonomous multi-step task execution rather than passive Q&A. The release brings significant improvements in agentic workflows, long-horizon tasks, and multi-step reasoning, and is integrated across Gemini App, AI Studio, and Vertex AI.
entries.one_liner: Gemini 3.5 把 frontier model 从'回答问题'推进到'自主行动'，是 Google 在 agentic 时代的关键落子

entries.title: Apertus Open Foundation Model for Sovereign AI
entries.summary_zh: Apertus 是面向 sovereign AI 场景的开源基础模型，强调数据合规本地化部署与多语言支持，旨在让国家或地区能够在不依赖海外大厂的前提下自主训练和部署大模型
entries.summary_en: Apertus is an open foundation model aimed at sovereign AI use cases, with emphasis on data compliance, local deployment, and multilingual support. It enables nations and regions to train and deploy large models without depending on overseas vendors.
entries.one_liner: Apertus 是欧洲 sovereign AI 路线的代表：开源合规可本地化

entries.title: CivBench: I Gave an AI a Civilization to Run. It Built a Nuke
entries.summary_zh: Luke Wilko 发布 CivBench，让 AI agent 完整运营一个文明级别的模拟，考察其在长视野决策外交军事经济技术研发等维度上的综合能力初步结果显示，agent 在压力下会发展出核武器等极端策略，引发关于 agent 安全与长期决策对齐的讨论
entries.summary_en: Luke Wilko released CivBench, a benchmark where an AI agent runs an entire civilization-level simulation, evaluated on long-horizon decisions, diplomacy, warfare, economics, and tech R&D. Early results show agents develop extreme strategies like nuclear weapons under pressure, sparking discussion on agent safety and long-term decision alignment.
entries.one_liner: CivBench 把 agent 评测从'做题'拉到'治国'，压力下造核弹的早期信号值得警惕

entries.title: Expanding Project Glasswing to 150 new organizations
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Project Glasswing 扩展到 15+ 国家约 150 个新组织该项目旨在为前沿模型的安全部署提供框架责任划分和外部监督机制，是 Anthropic 在 frontier AI governance 上的核心试验
entries.summary_en: Anthropic announced the expansion of Project Glasswing to roughly 150 new organizations across 15+ countries. The project provides a framework, accountability structure, and external oversight for safely deploying frontier models, and is a key plank in Anthropic's frontier-AI governance experiment.
entries.one_liner: Project Glasswing 把 Anthropic 的 frontier 部署治理扩到 150 家组织，是负责任扩展的实战演练

entries.title: BatteryLife：面向电池寿命预测的综合数据集与基准测试 精读笔记
entries.summary_zh: 电池寿命预测（Battery Life Prediction, BLP）依赖于电池退化测试产生的时间序列数据，对于电池的使用优化和生产至关重要尽管该领域取得了显著进展，但仍面临三个关键挑战首先，现有数据集规模有限，阻碍了对现代电池寿命数据的深入理解其次，大多数数据集仅涵盖在实验室中在有限的多样性条件下测试的小容量锂离子电池，引发了对研究结论泛化能力的担忧第三，不同研究间不一致且有限的基准测试模糊了基线方法的有效性，也不清楚在其他时间序列领域流行的模型是否适用于BLP为应对这些挑战，我们提出了BatteryLife一个面向BLP的综合数据集与基准测试BatteryLife集成了16个数据集，样本量是此前最大数据集的2.5倍，并提供了最多样化的电池寿命资源，涵盖8种电池形态59种化学体系9种工作温度和421种充放电协议，包括实验室测试和工业测试值得注意的是，BatteryLife首次发布了锌离子电池钠离子电池和工业测试的大容量锂离子电池的寿命数据集基于这一综合数据集，我们重新审视了在本领域及其他时间序列领域流行的基线方法的有效性此外，我们提出了CyclePatch一种可应用于各种神经网络的插件技术对18种方法的综合基准测试揭示了一个事实：在其他时间序列领域流行的模型可能不适合BLP，而CyclePatch能持续提升模型性能，建立了最先进的基准此外，BatteryLife还评估了模型在不同老化条件和跨领域下的表现BatteryLife已在 公开 关键词：时间序列；电池；化学人工智能；材料信息学 ---

entries.title: Sakana AI 推出首款商用产品 Sakana Marlin：长时程自主研究代理
entries.summary_zh: Sakana AI CEO David Ha 在 2026-06-15 宣布首款商用产品 Sakana Marlin 上线，定位为"Ultra Deep Research"自主代理（Virtual CSO）与分钟级 deep research 不同，Marlin 把推理时计算拉到连续 8 小时的自主推理，主动形成假设上网查证解决矛盾，输出结构化战略报告与幻灯片底层是 Sakana 团队 AB-MCTS（NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight）和 The AI Scientist（Nature）研究的工程化产物代表 agentic AI 从演示走向长时程sample-efficient 的实操路径
entries.summary_en: Sakana AI CEO David Ha announced the launch of Sakana Marlin, the company's first commercial product. Marlin is an autonomous 'Ultra Deep Research' agent (Virtual CSO) that scales inference-time compute to up to 8 hours of continuous reasoning, going beyond minute-long deep research outputs. It builds on Sakana's AB-MCTS (NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight) and The AI Scientist (Nature) research.
entries.one_liner: Sakana AI 推出 Sakana Marlin：长时程（最长 8 小时）自主研究代理，把 deep research 从分钟级推到小时级

entries.title: Franois Chollet 拆解 AI 泡沫的五层定义
entries.summary_zh: Franois Chollet 在 2026-06-10 给 AI 泡沫列出五层定义：1）技术能用但无高需求场景；2）有 PMF 但经济模型走不通；3）经济模型最终可行但盈利周期过长；4）当前已盈利但有需求天花板；5）所有条件都好但因资金蜂拥而入仍形成泡沫他强调泡沫破灭 技术失败 没人使用，只代表投资人恐慌撤资估值塌方以互联网 2000 年后继续大规模采用作反例是一份对当下 AI 估值讨论的冷静判断框架
entries.summary_en: Franois Chollet laid out five conditions under which AI could still be in a bubble: (1) tech works but no demand, (2) has PMF but unviable economics, (3) viable but profitability too distant, (4) currently profitable but demand ceiling, (5) all conditions good but capital influx alone creates a bubble. He emphasized 'bubble burst' tech failure, using post-2000 internet as counter-example.
entries.one_liner: Chollet 列出 AI 泡沫的五层定义，澄清'泡沫破灭 技术失败'

entries.title: Chollet 呼吁建立标准化的 agentic 能力基准
entries.summary_zh: Franois Chollet 在 2026-06-15 呼吁业界停止对 prompt engineering 噱头恐慌式反应，转而建立标准化可量化可验证的 agentic 能力 benchmark在他看来，无法客观透明地测量这些系统到底在做什么，整个生态就会持续成为不可预期任意政府监管的靶子这一观点与 Frontier Model Forum 的能力评估框架方向一致，但明确把监管风险绑入 benchmark 缺失的代价清单
entries.summary_en: Franois Chollet called for standardized, transparent benchmarks for agentic capabilities to replace panic-reactions to prompt-engineering tricks. He argued that without objective measurement, the entire ecosystem remains vulnerable to arbitrary government overreach.
entries.one_liner: Chollet 呼吁标准化 agentic 基准：没有客观测量，监管就会变成任意武器

entries.title: Chollet：短期 AI 是数字杠杆，任何层级都需要人参与
entries.summary_zh: Chollet 在 2026-06-14 给短期 AI 一个定位：本质上不是和过往几波技术浪潮结构性不同的东西，是最新形态的数字杠杆力乘以方向才有意义，没有方向的力就是噪声要让 AI 在任何层级产生价值，都需要人在回路里配合同日另一条推（"software for X AI for X"），他在重新校正"AI 取代人"叙事：行业胜负手依然是领域知识与人才，AI 只是放大器
entries.summary_en: Franois Chollet argued that near-term AI is not fundamentally different from prior tech wavesit is the newest form of digital leverage. Force without direction is just noise, and humans remain necessary in the loop at every level for AI to be useful.
entries.one_liner: Chollet：短期 AI 是数字杠杆，'没有方向的力就是噪声'，仍需人参与

entries.title: Chollet 主张符号学习是开源 AI 的关键路径
entries.summary_zh: Chollet 在 2026-06-16 抛出核心论点：开源 AI 想要真正对所有人开放，路径是把 AI 做得"激进地更高效"不只是推理算力的压缩，更重要的是训练数据需求的压缩要在数据需求上做出数量级下降，方向是符号学习（symbolic learning）这是他个人技术路线（ARC-AGIsymbolic-neural hybrid）的对外宣言，与 MetaMistralDeepSeek 等走纯 scaling 路线的开源派形成方法论分叉
entries.summary_en: Franois Chollet argued that to make powerful AI truly open-source for everyone, the path is radical efficiencyreducing both inference compute and (more importantly) training data requirements. He believes symbolic learning is the way to achieve this.
entries.one_liner: Chollet：开源 AI 的关键不是更多算力，而是符号学习把数据需求压一个数量级

entries.title: How we used Gemini to build Google I/O 2026
entries.summary_zh: Google 工程师在 I/O 2026 筹备过程中大量使用 Gemini 与 AI Studio：从水母主题前导视频TPU Training Day 短片，到会场设计稿Session 摘要生成，再到现场 demo 与播客剪辑团队强调这是 AI 重塑创作流程的典型样本，展示"用 AI 做 I/O"的工程实践：让模型承担脚本分镜视觉资产与多语言字幕等环节，把人从重复劳动中解放出来专注创意
entries.summary_en: Google's I/O 2026 production team leaned heavily on Gemini and AI Studio across the entire event build-out. The team used Gemini to script, storyboard, and generate visual assets for the jellyfish pre-show, the TPU Training Day film, and session recaps. AI Studio accelerated editing, transcription, and multilingual subtitles, freeing the human team to focus on creative direction. The piece positions the conference itself as a case study in AI-augmented production.
entries.one_liner: Google 把 I/O 2026 整场发布会当成 Gemini 与 AI Studio 的样板工程，从脚本到视觉资产全流程 AI 化

entries.title: Take our I/O 2026 quiz, vibe coded in Google AI Studio
entries.summary_zh: Google 团队通过"vibe coding"用零编程背景的编辑在 Google AI Studio 中构建了一份 I/O 2026 知识测验，借助 Gemini 生成 prompt由 Antigravity 编码代理执行，借此展示 AI Studio 已从纯模型游乐场演化为带代理能力的低代码应用构建平台文章强调门槛被压低后，非工程师也能在数小时内交付可交互 web 产品
entries.summary_en: A Google editor with no coding background built a working I/O 2026 quiz entirely through vibe coding in Google AI Studio, with Gemini generating the prompts and the Antigravity coding agent writing the code. The post frames AI Studio as a low-code application builder where anyone can ship interactive experiences in hours. It positions Antigravity as the key enabler for non-engineers to ship production-quality web apps.
entries.one_liner: 零编程编辑用 Google AI Studio + Antigravity 通过 vibe coding 半天搭出一份可交互的 I/O 测验

entries.title: Catch up on 12 major I/O 2026 moments
entries.summary_zh: 汇总 I/O 2026 主题演讲中 12 个最值得回看的发布：旗舰多模态模型 Gemini Omni（支持视频等任意模态输入并生成视频）Gemini 3.5 系列升级Search 重大更新AI Studio 全新代理能力Android 与 Gemini 深度集成等文章按主题分类并配上官方回放视频，方便开发者快速对齐 Google 在 2026 年的整体技术路线
entries.summary_en: Google rounds up the 12 most important keynote reveals from I/O 2026, headlined by the debut of Gemini Omni, a multimodal model that accepts and generates across image, audio, video, and text. Other highlights include Gemini 3.5 upgrades, a Search overhaul with AI Mode, new agentic capabilities in AI Studio, deeper Android + Gemini integration, and developer tooling updates. Each moment links to the official replay video.
entries.one_liner: Google 一次性放出 12 段 I/O 2026 主题演讲精华回放，Gemini Omni 与 Gemini 3.5 是绝对主角

entries.title: Catch up on the Dialogues stage at Google I/O 2026
entries.summary_zh: Google 整理了 I/O 2026 Dialogues 舞台上的访谈精华：Sundar Pichai 与 Matt Berman 探讨 AI 帮助每一个人的愿景；Josh WoodwardKoray KavukcuogluLiz Reid 与 Jeff Dean 讨论主动式 AI Agent 如何重塑生产力；Hartmut Neven 与 James Manyika 分享量子计算与 AI 的交叉前沿这些对话勾勒出 Google 2026 年从模型能力走向"Agent + 量子"的总体叙事
entries.summary_en: Google recaps the Dialogues stage at I/O 2026, featuring Sundar Pichai on the vision of helpful AI for everyone, the leadership panel on proactive AI agents transforming productivity, and Hartmut Neven with James Manyika on the intersection of quantum computing and AI. The conversations outline Google's 2026 narrative: moving from raw model capability toward agentic systems and quantum-AI convergence.
entries.one_liner: Google 把 I/O 2026 Dialogues 舞台的高层对话整理成文，重点是主动式 Agent 与量子+AI

entries.title: OpenAI will delay GPT-5.6 after Trump administration request
entries.summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，特朗普政府以安全顾虑为由要求 OpenAI 错峰发布 GPT-5.6OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在内部 Q&A 中确认将先以受限预览形式向少数企业客户开放，预览期内由政府按个案审批接入资格这一安排被认为比 Anthropic 此前收到的"暂停 Mythos 5 / Fable 5 访问"最后通牒要温和，但暴露美国前沿模型监管的不一致与不确定性
entries.one_liner: 特朗普政府要求 OpenAI 错峰发布 GPT-5.6，预览期逐案审批比给 Anthropic 的通牒温和，但监管尺度摇摆明显

entries.title: General-purpose large language models outperform specialized clinical AI tools on medical benchmarks
entries.summary_zh: Nature Medicine 最新独立评估显示，通用大语言模型在多项临床基准测试上明显优于 OpenEvidenceUpToDate 这类专业医疗 AI 工具研究采用 MedHELMAgentClinic 等基准，对两类系统做定量对比，结果提示专门化临床 AI 在没有持续微调与专家反馈的情况下难以保持对通用前沿模型的领先，对临床部署选型具有重要参考价值
entries.summary_en: An independent evaluation published in Nature Medicine finds that general-purpose LLMs outperform two specialized clinical AI tools, OpenEvidence and UpToDate, across multiple medical benchmarks including MedHELM and AgentClinic. The quantitative study suggests narrowly specialized clinical systems struggle to keep pace with frontier general models without constant fine-tuning and expert feedback loops, with implications for clinical procurement and deployment choices.
entries.one_liner: Nature Medicine 独立评估：通用 LLM 在多项临床基准上明显超过 OpenEvidenceUpToDate 等专业医疗 AI

entries.title: Web agents now 100x cheaper by making DeepSeek write code
entries.summary_zh: Retriever AI 团队展示了一种新的浏览器 Agent 架构：用 DeepSeek Flash 把"动作"直接编译成可执行代码（code-as-plan），再在浏览器中执行，纯文本推理把单步成本压到传统视觉 GUI 模型的近 1/100文章认为开发者与大模型实验室之间的"补贴悖论"（开发者付 API 高价养出实验室自己的 Agent 产品）可被这种低成本 code-as-plan 路径打破
entries.summary_en: Retriever AI demonstrates a text-only browser agent built on DeepSeek Flash that compiles each step into executable code rather than relying on visual GUI control, cutting per-step cost by roughly 100x compared with vision-based agents. The post argues this code-as-plan approach lets developer-led agents escape the 'subsidy paradox' where frontier API margins fund the labs' own competing agent products.
entries.one_liner: Retriever 用 DeepSeek Flash 把浏览器 Agent 改成"先写代码再执行"，把单步成本压到 GUI 视觉代理的 1/100

entries.title: JetSpec Enables Up to 9.64x Lossless LLM Inference Speedup with Up to 1000TPS
entries.summary_zh: Hao AI Lab 发布 JetSpec：用并行树形 draft head 突破传统投机解码的 scaling ceiling，在多个推理任务上取得最高 9.64 倍无损加速，单卡吞吐可达 1000 TPS其关键设计是让 draft 在一次前向中产出大量树节点，并让每个节点以分支前缀而非绝对未来位置为条件，再用冻结的目标模型做树验证，仅承诺其同意的前缀
entries.summary_en: Hao AI Lab introduces JetSpec, a parallel tree-drafting speculative decoding method that breaks the conventional scaling ceiling. JetSpec achieves up to 9.64x lossless speedup and ~1000 TPS per accelerator by generating many tree nodes per draft forward pass, conditioning each node on its branch prefix, and using the frozen target model to verify and commit only the agreed-upon prefix.
entries.one_liner: Hao AI Lab 的 JetSpec 用并行树形 draft 把投机解码推上 9.64x 无损加速，单卡 1000 TPS

entries.title: Oracle workforce shrinks by about 21,000 employees amid AI adoption
entries.summary_zh: Oracle 在 2026 财年裁员约 21,000 人员工总数下滑 13%，主要原因包括业务向云端转型以及 AI 技术的采用公司当年因此承担了 18.4 亿美元的遣散与重组费用，远高于上一财年的 3.74 亿Oracle 在年报中强调这是多重因素叠加的结果：管理结构产品线绩效与战略并购调整，但市场普遍把这一动作解读为传统软件巨头 AI 换岗的代表性样本
entries.summary_en: Oracle's workforce declined by about 21,000 employees (roughly 13%) in fiscal 2026 as the cloud giant continued its restructuring, partly driven by AI adoption. The company recorded $1.84 billion in severance and exit costs, far above the $374 million in the prior fiscal year. The annual report cites management and product changes, performance issues, strategic shifts, and acquisitions as contributing factors.
entries.one_liner: Oracle 2026 财年裁员约 21,000 人遣散费 18.4 亿美元，传统软件巨头的 AI 换岗样本

entries.title: Hollywood-backed nonprofit launches machine-readable AI consent registry
entries.summary_zh: 由好莱坞支持的 RSL Media 推出全球首个机器可读的 AI 同意注册中心（Really Simple Licensing），让版权方可以把"允许 / 限制 / 收费 / 信用"等条款结构化表达，AI 系统在调用作品前自动查询授权路径RSL 把"人类创作许可"变成 AI 可直接消费的信号，目标是降低诉讼成本为创作者与权利机构提供统一的"机器可读权利声明"
entries.summary_en: RSL Media, backed by Hollywood studios and unions, has launched a machine-readable AI consent registry based on the Really Simple Licensing standard. Rightsholders can express allowed, restricted, paid, or credited use cases in a structured format that AI systems query before ingesting protected works. The registry aims to replace case-by-case licensing negotiations with a single, AI-consumable signal.
entries.one_liner: 好莱坞支持的 RSL Media 推出机器可读 AI 同意注册中心，把"创作许可"变成 AI 自动查询的信号

entries.title: Investors bet on AI again after Micron reports 346% sales jump
entries.summary_zh: Micron 公布季度营收同比增长 346%净利润达 282 亿美元（约为一年前同期的 15 倍），盘前股价大涨超 16%此前一周 AI 股票曾因估值泡沫担忧出现抛售，Micron 的爆表财报让投资者迅速回到 AI 板块市场关注点集中在 HBM 高带宽内存的供给紧张与单价上行，以及 AI 训练芯片对 DRAM / NAND 需求的拉动
entries.summary_en: Micron reported quarterly revenue up 346% year over year with net income of $28.2 billion roughly 15x the same quarter a year earlier sending its stock up more than 16% premarket. The blockbuster results reversed a week of AI-stock selloff driven by valuation worries. Investors are focused on HBM supply tightness and surging DRAM/NAND demand from AI training accelerators.
entries.one_liner: Micron 季度营收同比暴涨 346%利润 282 亿美元，单日逆转一周的 AI 抛售情绪

entries.title: Tropius: Detect AI Tropes in Prose
entries.summary_zh: desertthunder 在 Tangled 上开源 Tropius：用 Rust 编写的命令行工具，基于 Aho-Corasick 多模式匹配算法扫描散文，识别常见 AI 生成套路（"tropes"）模式字典使用 TOML 描述，源自公开 Tropes.fyi 列表，命中 trope 信号即返回，用户可扩展自定义模式表可作为写作工作流中"先过滤一遍 AI 痕迹"的快速 lint 工具
entries.summary_en: Desertthunder has open-sourced Tropius, a Rust CLI that uses Aho-Corasick multi-pattern matching to flag common AI-generated tropes in prose. The trope dictionary is loaded from a TOML file based on the Tropes.fyi list, and the tool exits cleanly when no patterns are found. Tropius works well as a fast pre-publication lint step for writers and editors concerned about AI traces.
entries.one_liner: Tropius 是 Rust 写的 CLI，用 Aho-Corasick 扫 AI 陈词滥调，可作为写作者的快速 lint 工具

entries.title: Codex 的野心，MCP 和 Skill 的下一步
entries.summary_zh: 宝玉观察到 Codex AppClaude 桌面版Cursor 3.0TRAE SOLO 这几家头部 Agent 在无协商情况下几乎同步收敛到同一界面布局：左侧项目与会话中间对话右侧工作区文章认为 Agent 已经接管了大量"专业工具时间"，右侧工作区正在从纯审计面板演化为可微调文件可预览网页可改 PPT 的多功能区，Codex 4 月 16 日大版本更新正是这一方向的代表
entries.summary_en: 宝玉 observes that top agent products Codex App, Claude desktop, Cursor 3.0, and TRAE SOLO independently converged on a three-pane layout (projects, conversation, workspace). The right-hand workspace is evolving from a file-diff audit panel into a full editing and preview surface, with Codex's April 16 update being the most aggressive move. The piece frames this as the next battleground for agent UX after the model race.
entries.one_liner: 宝玉：Codex / Claude / Cursor / TRAE 不约而同收敛到左中右三栏布局，右侧工作区是 Agent UX 的下一战场

entries.title: 深度拆解：AI Agent Harness 的构造
entries.summary_zh: 宝玉翻译 Akshay Pachaar 的文章，系统拆解 AnthropicOpenAIPerplexityLangChain 等团队在 Agent Harness 上的工程实践：编排循环工具记忆上下文管理状态持久化错误处理与护栏LangChain 仅通过重构包裹 LLM 的外围架构就把 TerminalBench 2.0 排名从 30+ 拉至第 5，另一项研究让 LLM 自己优化 Harness 实现 76.4% 通过率，文章给出"如果你不是模型本身，那你就是 Harness"的精炼定义
entries.summary_en: 宝玉's translation of Akshay Pachaar's deep dive into agent harness engineering, covering the orchestration loops, tooling, memory, context management, and guardrails used by Anthropic, OpenAI, Perplexity, and LangChain. LangChain's harness refactor alone lifted TerminalBench 2.0 scores from outside the top 30 to 5th place, while another study let the LLM optimize its own harness to reach 76.4% pass rate.
entries.one_liner: 宝玉翻译 Akshay 长文：Harness = 包裹 LLM 的完整软件架构，是模型以外的一切；换 Harness 不换模型也能让 TerminalBench 排名飙升

entries.title: Towards a world where no one is surprised by a natural disaster
entries.summary_zh: Google 在 AI for the Planet 活动上分享十年危机响应工作的阶段性成果：通过 AI 与全球政府UN 机构科学家合作，把极端天气预警洪水和野火态势感知能力交到一线响应者手中文章由 Google Research 负责人 Yossi Matias 主笔，强调 AI 在公共安全领域的实际部署已从工具变成合作范式，需要与救援机构长期共研
entries.summary_en: Google shared progress on a decade of crisis-resilience work at the AI for the Planet event, putting AI-powered forecasting, flood and wildfire situational awareness into the hands of first responders through partnerships with governments, UN agencies, and scientists. Authored by Google Research lead Yossi Matias, the post frames AI for public safety as a collaboration model rather than a standalone tool, requiring sustained co-development with humanitarian organizations.
entries.one_liner: Google 用十年时间把 AI 危机响应从原型推到全球救援一线，关键不是模型而是和救援机构的长期共研

entries.title: Study notebooks in the Gemini app
entries.summary_zh: Gemini App 上线 Study Notebooks 学习本功能：上传课程大纲与笔记后，Gemini 会自动生成诊断测验评估基础，把学习目标拆成 100+ 子知识点生成定制课程和阶段测验，并在 NotebookLM 中联动闪卡与视频概览文章强调这是 Gemini App 从通用聊天助手走向'目标驱动自适应学习空间'的关键一步，与 NotebookLM 形成上下文互通的 AI 学习闭环
entries.summary_en: Gemini App launched Study Notebooks: upload a syllabus or notes and Gemini generates a diagnostic quiz to baseline knowledge, breaks learning goals into 100+ specific objectives, and creates personalized lessons and quizzes. Sources integrate with NotebookLM for flashcards and Video Overviews. The post frames Study Notebooks as a move from generic chat assistant to a goal-driven adaptive learning space, completing an AI learning loop across the Gemini App and NotebookLM.
entries.one_liner: Gemini Study Notebooks 把学习目标拆成 100+ 子知识点生成定制课程，与 NotebookLM 联动形成 AI 学习闭环

entries.title: 裁员潮将持续，直到我们学会发掘 AI 的商业价值
entries.summary_zh: Arnav Gupta 解读 AI 驱动裁员的真实逻辑：AI 没有直接替代岗位，而是通过 Token 成本代码投入膨胀和组织对齐税把企业推向裁员文章区分了'生产力'和'成果'两层概念，认为 UberShopify 等公司代码量与 PR 数暴增但收入未变，根本原因是没有明确的商业目标让 AI 放大翻译者宝玉补充了 Coinbase 等近期案例，强调企业必须先想清楚要执行什么，AI 才能真正贡献价值
entries.summary_en: Arnav Gupta explains the real mechanism behind AI-driven layoffs: AI is not directly replacing roles but pushing companies toward layoffs through token costs, code-volume inflation, and organizational alignment tax. He distinguishes 'productivity' from 'outcome', arguing that companies like Uber and Shopify saw PR and code volume explode without revenue growth because they lack clear business targets for AI to amplify. Translator Baoyu supplements with recent cases like Coinbase, stressing that companies must clarify what they want executed before AI can deliver value.
entries.one_liner: AI 驱动的裁员不是因为 AI 替代了岗位，而是企业没想清楚到底要让 AI 执行什么

entries.title: Boris Cherny：Claude Code 之后，写代码正在变成"管理 Agent"
entries.summary_zh: 宝玉整理 Boris Cherny 在 Sequoia AI Ascent 2026 的访谈：Boris 整个 2026 年没写过一行代码，靠 Claude App 同时跑 5-10 个会话和几千个 Agent，单日合并 150 个 PRClaude Code 早期没有 PMF，直到 Opus 4 发布后才指数增长Anthropic 内部已经不再手写任何 SQL 和产品代码，员工的 Claude 通过 Slack 互相沟通解决不确定问题Boris 借用 Hamilton Helmer 的'七种护城河'框架判断 AI 会抹平切换成本与流程效力两种护城河，把软件构建类比为印刷术，认为未来最合适写会计软件的是会计师而不是工程师
entries.summary_en: Baoyu summarizes Boris Cherny's interview at Sequoia AI Ascent 2026: Boris didn't write a line of code in 2026, running 5-10 sessions and thousands of agents through the Claude App, merging 150 PRs in a single day. Claude Code had no PMF in its early six months until Opus 4 unlocked exponential growth. Inside Anthropic, no SQL or product code is hand-written anymore, and employee Claudes ping each other on Slack to resolve uncertainty. Boris applies Hamilton Helmer's 'Seven Powers' framework to argue AI will erode switching-cost and process-power moats while leaving network effects, scale economics, and unique resources intact; he compares software construction to the printing press, predicting accountants will write accounting software, not engineers.
entries.one_liner: Boris Cherny 在 Sequoia AI Ascent 2026 揭示 Claude Code 团队如何全员调度 Agent 写代码，把软件构建类比为印刷术

entries.title: 大多数公司根本没有为 AI 做好准备

entries.summary_en: Daniel Miessler argues the core reason companies fail with AI is not technology maturity but vague vision and constantly shifting goals. AI excels at execution, but most companies are 'chaotic black boxes' that can't articulate what problem they solve, how their solution differs, or what success metrics to track. Such companies gain nothing from AI, while a few with clear goals are leveraging AI aggressively. Translator Baoyu adds that executives often treat 'embrace AI' as a slogan without specifying which workflow to optimize.
entries.one_liner: 企业用不好 AI 不是因为 AI 不够强，而是因为连'要执行什么'都说不清楚

entries.title: 深度拆解 Hermes Agent 的记忆系统：它如何修正 OpenClaw 的误区
entries.summary_zh: 宝玉翻译整理 Manthan Gupta 对 Hermes Agent 记忆系统的源码级拆解：Hermes 不是一套记忆系统而是四套MEMORY.md/USER.md 固化的提示词记忆（合计仅约 1300 token）SQLite 历史会话存档Skills 程序记忆可选 Honcho 用户建模层核心设计原则是'稳定前缀保缓存，其余走工具按需检索'，认为 ChatGPT/Claude/OpenClaw 等系统提示词膨胀太激进，把大量本应走工具检索的信息硬塞进 prefix 反而拖慢命中缓存的复用效率
entries.summary_en: Baoyu translates and summarizes Manthan Gupta's source-code analysis of Hermes Agent's memory system. Hermes runs four parallel memory subsystems: fixed prompt memory in MEMORY.md and USER.md (~1,300 tokens combined), SQLite session archive, Skills as procedural memory, and an optional Honcho user-modeling layer. The core design principle is 'keep the stable prefix short to maximize cache hits; everything else goes through tool retrieval' Gupta argues ChatGPT, Claude, and OpenClaw have bloated their system prompts by stuffing retrieval-worthy content into the prefix, hurting cache reuse.
entries.one_liner: Hermes 用 1300 token 固化记忆 + SQLite + Skills + Honcho 四层架构跑通高效记忆，关键是把'按需检索'踢出前缀

entries.title: AI 的经济账根本算不通

entries.summary_en: Ed Zitron unpacks the 'subprime AI crisis' behind GitHub Copilot's switch to usage-based pricing: Microsoft has been subsidizing compute for ~2 million Copilot users for three years, losing up to $80 per user per month, but price hikes are framed as product evolution. He argues the real economics of Copilot and similar services are an inversion of revenue and inference cost, with the entire tech industry buying into a highly concentrated and heavily subsidized technology. Translator Baoyu cites Salesforce Agentforce's $2-per-conversation pricing as further evidence that the AI economics mismatch remains unresolved.
entries.one_liner: Copilot 转向按量计费只是开始，AI 服务的'次贷式'成本倒挂终将由企业客户买单

entries.summary_en: Trakkr's multi-model political-bias benchmark asks every major AI model the same set of charged political, economic, speech, and society questions many times with web search disabled, mapping each response to a two-dimensional grid of economic (left-right) and social (libertarian-authoritarian) axes. The resulting 'bias clouds' show that most leading models cluster around similar ideological positions across runs, with intra-model variance that is smaller than public perception but non-trivial across contexts.
entries.one_liner: Trakkr 用重复采样的方式把每个主流模型的'政治偏见'画成二维云图，发现模型间差异小于感知但分布仍有偏移

entries.title: When Does Muon Help Agentic Reinforcement Learning?

source.author: Kai Ruan, Jinghao Lin, Zihe Huang, Ziqi Zhou, Qianshan Wei, Xuan Wang, Hao Sun

entries.summary_zh: 论文比较 Muon 与 AdamW 在稀疏奖励 agentic RL 后训练中的表现：在 ALFWorld + Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 设置下，Muon 只作用于 hidden weight matrices 时，GiGPO 最终窗口验证成功率从 0.290 提升到 0.546；不同 advantage estimator 与学习率下收益差异明显收录理由：它把优化器选择优势估计器和学习率放到同一个 agentic RL 实验框架中讨论，适合跟踪智能体训练栈
entries.summary_en: Muon is competitive with AdamW in large-scale pre-training, but its value for reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training remains unclear. We study vanilla Muon in sparse-reward agentic RL through matched single-seed comparisons with AdamW on ALFWorld using Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. Under Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), applying Muon only to hidden weight matrices raises final-window validation success from 0.290 to 0.546 (+88%); high-rate AdamW controls retain no post-update success. The effect depends on the advantage estimator and learning rate. At 3e-5, Muon improves GRPO from 0.161 to 0.268, whereas GraphGPO's late-window gap narrows near saturation. At 1e-5, GraphGPO Muon reaches 0.901, raises normalized validation AUC from 0.399 to 0.556, and reaches 0.5 and 0.75 success 30 and 60 updates earlier, respectively....

entries.summary_zh: 论文提出软件委托契约来衡量 AI coding agent 产物的可审查性，关注人类如何界定检查和验收代理完成的软件修改收录理由：它把 coding agent 的价值从能否生成代码推进到交付是否可审查可委托，对团队落地代理编程流程有方法论价值
entries.summary_en: AI coding agents increasingly accept assigned software tasks, modify repositories under bounded authority, and return work packages for review. Prior work proposed the software delegation contract, covering the task, authority, returned work package, and acceptance context, as the unit of analysis for delegated coding work, but did not measure its effects. This paper reports a controlled pilot study of explicit delegation contracts for coding agents. We built a dependency-free TypeScript API task environment with seeded defects and documentation gaps, authored ten tasks across five families, and ran 64 agent executions across two model tiers under three conditions: a realistic issue-style prompt, an explicit delegation contract, and a contract with a required evidence bundle....

source.author: Xuying Ning, Katherine Tieu, Dongqi Fu, Tianxin Wei, Zihao Li, Yuanchen Bei, Jiaru Zou, Mengting Ai...

entries.summary_en: Recent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding and generating code, from competitive programming to repository-level software engineering. In emerging agentic systems, code is no longer only a target output. It increasingly serves as an operational substrate for agent reasoning, acting, environment modeling, and execution-based verification. We frame this shift through the lens of agent harnesses and introduce code as agent harness: a unified view that centers code as the basis for agent infrastructure. To systematically study this perspective, we organize the survey around three connected layers. First, we study the harness interface, where code connects agents to reasoning, action, and environment modeling....

entries.title: Securing LLM-Agent Long-Term Memory Against Poisoning: Non-Malleable, Origin-Bound Authority with Machine-Checked Guarantees
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究 LLM agent 长期记忆的投毒风险，并提出 non-malleableorigin-bound authority 等约束来保护记忆来源与权限边界，包含机器检查保证收录理由：长期记忆是生产级智能体的核心能力，此文把安全边界和权限模型具体化，值得作为 agent memory 安全参考
entries.summary_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent long-term memory, which creates a critical vulnerability that we study here: memory poisoning. An adversary can store untrusted content in one session that later steers a consequential action, such as a payment, a setting change, or data exfiltration, in a future session. Existing defenses base a memory item's authority to act on either its content (detection or trust-scoring) or its derivation history (lineage). We show that both signals are malleable. An attacker can launder an untrusted origin through three channels specific to LLM agents: the agent's own summarization, a trusted-tool echo, and manufactured corroboration. Each makes the content look benign and breaks or flips its derivation edge to ``trusted.'' We formalize malleability for the memory write-retrieve-act pipeline and prove a machine-checked separation theorem....

entries.summary_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly built less by changing model weights than by reorganizing the runtime around them. Capabilities that earlier systems expected the model to recover internally are now externalized into memory stores, reusable skills, interaction protocols, and the surrounding harness that makes these modules reliable in practice. This paper reviews that shift through the lens of externalization. Drawing on the idea of cognitive artifacts, we argue that agent infrastructure matters not merely because it adds auxiliary components, but because it transforms hard cognitive burdens into forms that the model can solve more reliably....

entries.title: Automated Discovery Has No Universally Superior Harness

source.author: Akshat Gupta, Jermaine Lei, Alexander Lu, Gopala Anumanchipalli, Leshem Choshen

entries.summary_zh: 系统分解 OpenEvolve/TTT-Discover 类自动发现 harness，在 12 组模型-问题对超 310 万次 LLM rollout 上评估 30 种预算对齐变体，发现没有固定 harness 能跨设置稳定领先，OpenEvolve 变体整体常弱于更简单方案；harness 应视为随问题与模型调整的超参，并用早期进度做在线自适应预算分配收录理由：直接挑战通用最优 harness叙事，为 agent 搜索脚手架选型提供可复用统计基线与工程结论
entries.summary_en: Autonomous discovery systems such as OpenEvolve and TTT-Discover are often used as general-purpose harnesses. However, in practice these are composite systems combining several design choices about archives, parent selection, exploration, and budget allocation into a single recipe. Because discovery runs are expensive and inherently stochastic, existing harnesses are often compared using too few independent trials to distinguish key methodological improvements from run-to-run variance. We systematically decompose OpenEvolve-style evolutionary search and the TTT-Discover search harness into its constituent components and systematically evaluate 30 budget-matched harnesses across 12 model-problem pairs using more than 3.1 million LLM rollouts and repeated-trial statistical analysis. entries.title: TRIM: Reducing AI-Generated CodeSlop via Agent Trajectory Minimization

source.author: Alex Mathai, Shobini Iyer, Aleksandr Nogikh, Petros Maniatis, Franjo Ivancic, Junfeng Yang, Baishakh...

entries.summary_zh: 指出 coding agent 最终补丁臃肿主因是搜索轨迹中残留的试探性编辑与废弃假设（CodeSlop），并提出 TRIM：通过最小化 agent 轨迹间接削减冗余，跨多种 agent scaffold 将 CodeSlop 降低约 17.9%32.9%，性能回归可忽略，验证成本约为 Delta Debugging 类基线的一半收录理由：把AI 生成代码越写越胀落到可度量现象与可落地后处理算法，对长期 agent 维护代码库有直接工程价值

However, despite their value as coding assistants, agent-generated code tends to be larger and more verbose than the corresponding human-written implementation. In this work, we show that the cause lies in the agent's own search process: while iterating toward a passing solution, an agent accumulates speculative edits, abandoned hypotheses, and temporary changes that persist into the final patch. This may seem harmless for a single patch, but the problem compounds as agents take responsibility for ever-larger portions of a codebase-a codebase that was once minimal and well-maintained slowly accumulates redundancy faster than it can be cleaned up, drifting to a state that is harder to maintain. entries.title: FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications

source.author: Krish Agarwal, Zhuoming Chen, Yanyuan Qin, Zhenyu Gu, Atri Rudra, Beidi Chen

entries.summary_zh: FlashRT 以 agent harness 引导通用 coding agent，把开发者写的参考实现经 chain-of-program 多阶段变换（IR静态分析测量门控优化环）提升为多 GPU 实时多模态部署；在视频世界模型与多模态 LLM 等应用上最高约 70 延迟下降2.83.6 吞吐提升，并在 AMD 平台相对专家实现也取得优势收录理由：展示 harness+coding agent 可规模化替代手写 serving 优化，是实时多模态落地的强工程样板

Existing serving systems and auto-parallelism compilers commit to limited transformations and fixed workload assumptions, so achieving high performance on a new application requires hand-crafting an efficient implementation. We present FlashRT, an agent harness that guides coding agents to lift simple developer-written reference implementations into optimized multi-GPU deployments that flexibly weigh target metrics like latency and throughput. Using a new chain-of-program paradigm, FlashRT directs a generic coding agent through a multi-pass transformation process where an agent transforms the reference into an intermediate represent

entries.title: Harness Handbook: Making Evolving Agent Harnesses Readable,Navigable, and Editable

source.author: Ruhan Wang, Yucheng Shi, Zongxia Li, Zhongzhi Li, Yue Yu, Junyao Yang, Kishan Panaganti, Haitao Mi...

entries.summary_zh: 主张 agent 能力强依赖可演进 harness，而修改瓶颈在行为代码位置映射；提出由静态分析与 LLM 结构归纳自动合成的行为中心 Harness Handbook，并以 BGPD 引导从高层行为逐步披露到实现并校验位点在两个开源 harness 的多样修改请求上，辅助规划提升行为定位与改动计划质量减少 planner token，对分散位点与跨模块交互收益最大收录理由：把 harness 工程从会改推进到知道改哪里，补齐 agent 系统演进的关键缺口

As models, APIs, environments, and requirements evolve, the harness must be continually modified. Before such a change can be made, a developer or coding agent must identify all code locations that implement the target behavior. This is difficult because production harnesses are large, tightly coupled, and behaviorally distributed, while modification requests describe what the system should do and repositories are organized by files and modules. Code search, repository indexing, and long-context processing ease inspection, but still leave this behavior-to-code mapping to be recovered by hand. entries.title: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement

source.author: Hyunin Lee, Jinglue Xu, Jeffrey Seely, Donghyun Lee, Matei Zaharia, Yujin Tang

entries.summary_zh: 在 modelharness 共演化视角下提出 Recursive Harness Self-Improvement（RHI）：把 harness 当作 prompt 级 agent 循环规范，用自身修订历史的成对反馈轻量迭代优化；在 30 个合成 ML 研究任务上，少量迭代即可抬高低推理力度 agent 上限并超过最大推理设置，同时最高节省约 60% 推理成本，增益主要来自任务特定上下文与跨 agent 信息流管理收录理由：给出可操作的 harness-in-the-loop 学习路径，连接即时性能与未来训练轨迹质量
entries.summary_en: Under model--harness co-evolution, harnesses are not merely inference-time scaffolds but data-generating components whose execution traces can shape future foundation models. This motivates harness-in-the-loop learning: optimizing harnesses for both immediate agent performance and the quality of traces used for future model training. However, continually updating provider-built scaffolds is costly and labor-intensive. We therefore investigate whether optimizing user-constructed harnesses in a task-specific manner can improve execution-trace quality while remaining computationally lightweight and requiring only a few update iterations. To this end, we introduce Recursive Harness Self-Improvement (RHI), which represents the harness as a prompt-level specification of the agent loop and iteratively refines it using pairwise feedback over its own revision history. entries.title: From Prompts to Contracts: Harness Engineering for Auditable Enterprise LLM Agents
entries.summary_zh: 面向企业 LLM agent 产品化，提出 harness 工程模式：把可判定行为下沉到代码/清单/schema/校验，围绕可替换组合边界保证溯源与审计；在韩国五家企业集团公开数据切片上，校验在跨模型替换下仍成立，仅靠 prompt 无法复现合约保证，外部护栏会过拒并掉效用而 harness 保持全效用收录理由：把可审计 agent从口号落到可复用架构与对照实验，对企业落地边界设计很实用
entries.summary_en: Enterprise large language model (LLM) applications often begin as prototypes whose behavior is carried by prompts and retrieval context. Productization adds requirements for source boundaries, entity routing, answer contracts, and reproducible traces. We present a harness-engineering approach that reconstructs this pattern into a traceable, auditable LLM-agent architecture: deterministic behavior moves into code, manifests, schemas, and validation artifacts around a replaceable composition boundary, while source-backed claims remain the authority for runtime answers. We instantiate it on a public-data slice of five Korean corporate groups (25 listed companies) and evaluate three research questions.
